Allahabad High Court seeks government and ASI response in Taj Mahal dispute

The Allahabad High Court has requested the central government and the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) to submit counter-affidavits in a case concerning the Taj Mahal, referred to by some as 'Tejo Mahalaya'. The court's directive is in response to a petition related to the historical status of the monument. This development indicates a judicial process underway to address claims about the Taj Mahal's origins.
